after-completing-recipe-for-disaster-fre.npc: Welcome to my BASEMENT OF DOOM!

after-completing-recipe-for-disaster-fre.text: If the player has a hellcat with them:

steps.npc: Woah, that's one totally evil cat! It looks way more evil than you!

after-completing-recipe-for-disaster-fre.text: If the player is wearing ghostly robes or black graceful:

steps.npc: That outfit is TOTALLY EVIL! I'm almost scared of you!

after-completing-recipe-for-disaster-fre.text: If the player is wearing ghostly robes or black graceful and has a hellcat with them:

steps.npc: That outfit is TOTALLY EVIL! And you've got an evil cat too! To be honest I'm a little bit scared of you!

steps.player: Nice basement!

steps.npc: Nice?!

steps.player: I mean, evil!

steps.npc: Yeah! I'm going to use it to summon DEMONS to DO MY BIDDING, or raise an ARMY OF THE UNDEAD! And then I'm going to totally, like, take over the world!
Ah-ha-ha-ha-ha-haa!

options.text: So have you had any luck with the demon-summoning?

steps.player: So have you had any luck with the demon-summoning?

steps.npc: Well, I thought I should start small, so I asked Wizard Grayzag for some help with summoning imps...

steps.player: And did you manage to summon any?

steps.npc: Well, not imps, exactly. It turns out they're not the lowest form of demon after all. I got these hell-rats.
They're hardly evil at all! They're just like regular rats only they smell vaguely of sulphur!

options.text: Weren't you going to give up evil?

steps.player: See you later!

steps.npc: If my ARMY OF DARKNESS doesn't get you first!
Soon you will return to bow before my EVIL THRONE!
If you can find your way out of my BASEMENT OF DOOM!
And together we will lead Gielinor into a NEW DARK AGE!
Of course you will return! There is no escape from my DARK POWER!

options.text: Weren't you going to give up evil?

steps.player: Weren't you going to give up evil?

steps.npc: Yeah, well...
I did try. I wore this bright red jumper and I got up in the morning and spent the day outside in the sunshine...
But I couldn't keep it up. I just didn't find anything good very interesting, you know?
Sometimes I worry about the consequences of evil. I don't really want anyone to get hurt, not like what happened with Denath.
But I can't not be evil! It's just who I am!
Ah-ha-ha-ha-ha-haa!

options.text: Let me try to explain the time travel thing again...

steps.player: Let me try to explain the time travel thing again...

options.text: Although you're here, you're also still in the time freeze.

steps.player: Although you're here, you're also still in the time freeze.

steps.npc: What?

steps.player: I mean, the whole room was frozen in time at the moment the culinomancer cast his spell, right?

steps.npc: What? I didn't notice anything.

steps.player: Of course you didn't! You were frozen!

steps.npc: So how can I be there and also here? Which one is me?
I mean, I feel like I'm me, but what if I'm not me?
That would be terrible!

steps.player: They're both you!

steps.npc: How does that work?

options.text: From YOUR point of view I've saved you, but from MINE I haven't.

steps.player: From YOUR point of view I've saved you, but from MINE I haven't.

steps.npc: Well that's all right, as long as I'm saved from my point of view!

steps.player: But I have to save you, otherwise you won't be saved!

steps.npc: But I'm here so you must already have saved me!

steps.player: That's what I meant, from your point of view I've saved you but from mine I haven't!

steps.npc: What?

options.text: I've got to take the food back in time to give it to you.

steps.player: I've to take the food back in time to give it to you.

steps.npc: Why?

steps.player: Because otherwise you won't be saved from the culinomancer's spell.

steps.npc: But I was saved from the spell! I remember it!

steps.player: Exactly! That's why I know I have to go back and save you!

steps.npc: What will happen if you don't?

options.text: I can't not, I already have!

steps.player: I can't not, because I already have!

steps.npc: What?

steps.player: The fact that you're here means I already did save you, which means that you have to tell me the correct recipe. It's logically impossible for you not to!

steps.npc: I don't understand this at all.

options.text: There will be a temporal paradox and the universe will implode!

steps.player: There will be a temporal paradox and the universe will implode!

steps.npc: Oh no! That would be bad, and not even in an evil way!

steps.player: Exactly! So you've got to tell me the recipe!

steps.npc: But I still don't understand why you need the recipe when you've already saved me!

steps.player: I don't know.

steps.npc: That's not very helpful. I don't even understand why you need the recipe anyway.

options.text: You've got to tell me because the magic requires it!

steps.player: You've got to tell me because the magic requires it!

steps.npc: That's what you said before! Honestly, why make it more complicated than it needs to be?

steps.player: Oh, never mind.

treasure-trails-hard.npc: I need you to answer this for me.

treasure-trails-hard.text: Evil Dave has given you a challenge scroll!

treasure-trails-hard-when-talked-to-agai.npc: Please enter the answer to the question.

steps.npc: That is not the evil answer I requested!
Spot on!

steps.text: Evil Dave has given you another clue scroll!
